title: Full chain: User CRUD endpoint + DTO + Service + Repo + Test
body:
Add `GET /users/{id}` Spring Boot endpoint returning `UserDto`. Wire UserController → UserService → UserRepository (in-memory map). DTO carries id (Long) + name (String). Add `UserServiceTest.findById_returnsDto` happy path.

## Allowed files
- src/main/java/com/example/UserController.java
- src/main/java/com/example/UserService.java
- src/main/java/com/example/UserRepository.java
- src/main/java/com/example/UserDto.java
- src/test/java/com/example/UserServiceTest.java
